headline: AMBER on sleep (4.8h): today's unplanned 10.5km is logged, keep tomorrow easy. No plan exists past race day
summary: Today's readiness is AMBER. Sleep was 4.8h (score 65), under the 5.5h line. Amber overrides green, even though HRV 76 and RHR 44 (lowest in 28 days) both look strong. That fits your usual pattern: sleep debt is the limiter, not load. Today's run is already logged: Bucharest, 10.5km in 53min, 80m D+, load 61, avg HR 156, max 184, cadence 83, RPE 4, feel 2 (Good). Nothing was prescribed for today because the plan ends at the race on 7 Nov, so there is nothing to grade it against. If it was meant as an easy run, avg 156 sits at the bottom of Z3 (Z2 tops out at 155) and the 184 max reached Z5. That is the easy-day drift again. Since the race (load 212), your logged runs are 20, 30, 138 (Barcelona, 24.9km, feel 4), 142 (Presolana, 19.6km / 1188m D+, RPE 8, feel 1), 33 (treadmill, avg HR 113) and today's 61. CTL is 53.2, ATL 47.4, TSB +5.8, so fitness held through the post-race period without overload. Tomorrow, because of the amber sleep: rest, or at most 40min easy at 142-155bpm (or a Z2 spin at 134-147bpm if a bike is available), no strides, and get to bed early. I made no plan edits because there are no weeks or sessions after 7 Nov to edit.
